nodes.question: What methods were used to identify potential risks associated with waste production in the EHS RM methodology implementation?
nodes.answer: Several audits were carried out to inspect activities, products, materials, substances, machineries, and plants. Interviews with employees, observation of production lines and plants, and analysis of production data were conducted.
